metrics.name: Organizational Diversity
metrics.explanation: Organisations are told apart by the email domain of the commits of the last 12 months (62 commits by people, after the .mailmap) and, for a personal or hidden address, by the company on the author's public profile. The largest is an organisation with one author, with 98% of the 62 commits whose organisation is known; 0% of the commits come from 0 of 2 authors whose organisation stays unknown. Only these counts are kept, no names, addresses or companies; an organisation is named only when several authors share it.
